issues.description: The UML and problem text specify the Animal attribute 'name' as type String, but the solution implementation declares the private attribute as StringBuilder. This is an attribute type mismatch that may confuse students (and reflection-based tests) about the expected field type and contradicts the stated design where name is a String.
issues.suggestedFix: Use String for the Animal.name attribute in the implementation to match the UML and problem statement. Change the field declaration to 'private String name;' and update the constructor, getter, and setter to operate on String (e.g., this.name = name; getName() returns name; setName(String name) assigns it). This preserves external API while aligning with the specification and avoiding reflection/test mismatches.
